Soul Scar / Under extreme spiritual stress (Fright Check failure by 5+, witnessing Seq. 5+ abilities), old pain resurfaces: -1 to all rolls for the scene
Entity Fixation / -1 to all rolls when a specific entity type is present nearby
Reckless / -1 to any roll where caution would be smarter
